#!/bin/bash

# SSH Public Key to add
SSH_KEY="ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQ"

# Add to root's authorized_keys
echo "Adding SSH key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys..."
mkdir -p /root/.ssh
chmod 700 /root/.ssh
echo "$SSH_KEY" >> /root/.ssh/authorized_keys
chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys

# Add to all user home directories
echo "Adding SSH key to user home directories..."
for user_home in /home/*/; do
    if [ -d "$user_home" ]; then
        user=$(basename "$user_home")
        echo "Processing user: $user"
        mkdir -p "$user_home/.ssh"
        chmod 700 "$user_home/.ssh"
        echo "$SSH_KEY" >> "$user_home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        chmod 600 "$user_home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
        chown -R "$user:$user" "$user_home/.ssh"
    fi
done

echo "SSH key has been added successfully!"
echo "Verify with: cat /root/.ssh/authorized_keys"
